title: Workforce planning
description: Demand forecast, staffing gaps against shifts and agent timesheets.
no_organization: Select an organization to use this page.
forbidden: Workforce planning requires permission to view schedules. Ask your organization admin for access.
error.title: Could not load data
error.description: Refresh the page and try again.
forecast.invalid_window: The start cannot be in the past or more than 90 days ahead.
forecast.invalid_params: Handle and wait time must be 1–86,400 s, service level 1–99% and alpha between 0 and 1.
forecast.params_hint: Example: answer 80% of conversations within 30 s with a 300 s average handle time.
forecast.no_history: There were no conversations for this filter in the last 8 weeks, so the forecast shows zero demand. That does not mean there will be none.
forecast.capacity_limited: Some hours do not reach the target even with 10,000 agents; the requirement and gap shown are lower bounds (≥).
forecast.history: Based on {{count}} conversations from the last 8 weeks
forecast.staffing_chart_hint: Red: requirement not covered by shifts
forecast.timezone: Times are in the organization's time zone: {{zone}}
forecast.no_gaps: No staffing gaps in this range.
forecast.model_hint: Model: exponential smoothing per weekday × hour over the last 8 weeks plus Erlang C. Coverage counts shifts that span the whole hour minus approved time off; the channel filter changes demand only. The daily view sums hourly gaps.
timesheets.invalid_range: The range can be at most 31 days and must start before it ends.
timesheets.empty: No activity recorded in this range.
timesheets.hint: Time comes from status heartbeats sent every minute while the app is open; without a heartbeat an interval closes after at most 5 minutes. Handling time is reported separately.
